name: c-c0rtex
description: QA tooling for Claude Code by c-c0rtex: web-qa and tg-qa, with api-qa to come.

plugins.name: web-qa
plugins.description: Autonomous web-app QA: Playwright E2E, visual regression, axe-core accessibility — scenarios generated from a git diff or a task, specs grounded in a crawled app map, zero-token test runs, self-healing failures.

plugins.name: tg-qa
plugins.description: Autonomous Telegram-bot QA: Telethon-driven E2E dialogs, reply & keyboard snapshot testing, specs generated from the bot's source code, zero-token test runs, media/stickers/voice, Mini App handoff to web-qa.
